push.title: Turn "someone should test the migration" into named owners, at 8:30
push.body: Three validation hand-offs in DELEGATED.md were never actually handed over, and all three gate the April demo. Priya already scoped them as tickets, so hand [PLAT-2456](https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-2456) and [PLAT-2457](https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-2457) to people, not a category to a team.

push.seed:
Turn the three migration validation hand-offs on my delegated list into something I can actually hand over at the Platform Standup this morning. All three sit as team names with no return date, and all three gate the April demo.

Where to look: DELEGATED.md items D1 to D4 and TASKS.md, both in the PersonalOS Obsidian vault. In Jira, epic PLAT-2443 (Reporting Rewrite) and its open validation stories PLAT-2456 (Accounting) and PLAT-2457 (Contacts), plus PLAT-2458 (deployment hardening), which is the gate immediately before sign-off. Also DATA-412 (staging sync failures), which may be the same root cause as the blocker on the contacts story.

For each hand-off give me a named person rather than a team, the exit criteria that count as done, a return date, and the one thing that would block that person on day one. Then draft the short message I send each owner straight after the standup. Last, tell me what to say to Dana about the production URL I owe by Friday.

You can reach Jira, Slack, Gmail, Google Drive, Circleback and my vault.

Check whether the reporting service account's access token is still load-bearing before I regenerate anything, because the recurring calendar reminder may simply be stale.

Where to look: Jira issue DATA-412 (complete service-account migration) and its predecessor DATA-208. DATA-412 records that the warehouse moved to RSA key-pair authentication on 9 March, documented in docs/warehouse_auth.md, and that the break-glass token runs to 9 March 2027. In the warehouse, check the reporting user for auth type, key-pair status and whether the network policy is still attached.

Tell me either that today's expiry is a non-event and I can delete the recurring reminder, or exactly which dashboards still need reconnecting today. You can reach Jira, the warehouse, Gmail, Slack and the web. Finish with a short answer I can paste into the Platform Standup.

day.p: You organize this, with Priya and the vendor team. Natural forum for the production URL and the OAuth client cap still open in two regions and staging.

Build me an agenda for the Platform Standup I run this morning with Priya and the vendor team. Three things need to land.

First, the production URL for the new reporting app, which I committed to Dana by end of this week. Second, the OAuth client registration cap: one region hit its hard limit of 100 registered clients and blocked every new sign-in, fixed with a TTL expiry in pull request 412 on acme-co/platform, and the other two regions and staging will hit the same wall. Where to look: Jira epic PLAT-2443 and its open children PLAT-2456, PLAT-2457 and PLAT-2458. On GitHub, pull requests 412 and 409 on acme-co/platform. Recent history in the #platform Slack channel.

You can reach Jira, Slack, GitHub and the web. Give me a short agenda with a named owner and a date against each item.
